# `ρ` — Shape / Reshape

Function. Keys: `Alt-r`. Hanzi: `形`. Ranks: `∞` monadic, `1 ∞` dyadic

`ρY` gives axis lengths.

```bpl
ρ2 3ρ0             ⍝ [2 3]ₓ
```

The shape is keyed by the axis names. An unnamed axis gives an unkeyed entry. See [named axes](../keyed.ipynb#named-axes).

```bpl
M←["city":2 "month":3]ρι6ₓ
ρM                 ⍝ ["city":2 "month":3]ₓ
"month"⌷ρM         ⍝ 3ₓ
```

`SρY` reshapes, cycling or truncating the ravel of `Y`. Dimensions are nonnegative whole numbers. Empty `Y` supplies fill, which [`⍠`](quad-colon.qmd#fill) can choose.

```bpl
2 3ρ1 2            ⍝ [1 2 1◇2 1 2]
3ρ""               ⍝ "   "
```

An empty shape makes a rank-zero array.

```bpl
⍬ρ1 2              ⍝ ⊂1
```

A keyed `S` names the axes of the result. An unkeyed `S` gives no names. When `S` matches the shape of `Y`, the result keeps the position keys of `Y`.

```bpl
ρ["city":2 3]ρι6ₓ   ⍝ ["city":2 3]ₓ
```

## Inverse

`Sρ⁻Y` ravels `Y`, which must have shape `S`.

```bpl
2 3ρ⁻2 3ρι6ₓ   ⍝ [0 1 2 3 4 5]ₓ
```
